summary: Contestants research and create a multimedia presentation about modern entrepreneurship, covering its benefits, challenges, technology's impact, and skills needed. The presentation must include real-world examples, practical tips, and be delivered professionally with proper documentation. Judging is based on delivery, organization, content knowledge, responses to questions, and adherence to event requirements.
time_limits: No more than three (3) minutes for setup
No less than seven (7) and no more than ten (10) minutes for oral presentation
No more than five (5) minutes judges’ questions
Presentation will be stopped at ten (10) minutes
submission_requirements: Works Cited formatted in accordance with the Style & Reference Manual
AI Usage and Documentation Form for each round of the event (preliminary and final)
what_to_bring: One single-sided laptop, notebook, or tablet for presentation
competencies: Create a clear, engaging multimedia presentation using modern digital tools to enhance key ideas
Use charts, graphs, and other visuals correctly and clearly to present information and support key ideas
Deliver a professional, well-organized oral presentation using effective verbal and nonverbal communication skills
Use credible research, facts, and supporting data to strengthen key ideas within the presentation
Analyze the assigned topic and organize a clear message using an effective introduction, body, and conclusion
Prepare and submit a properly formatted Works Cited page that follows BPA’s Style & Reference Manual
Respond to judge questions clearly and confidently, using examples or reasoning to support your answers

rubric.criterion: Contestant followed the Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines, and the Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy.

rubric.description: Contestant maintains good eye contact, uses appropriate gestures and body language, and varies their tone and pace adequately.
The presentation content flows adequately, and the contestant demonstrates a clear and well-integrated structure throughout.
Presentation demonstrates a good understanding of the topic and includes relevant and accurate information
Responses are detailed, insightful, and effectively address the judges' questions.

Setup lasted no longer than three (3) minutes, presentation lasted no less than seven (7) minutes and no longer than ten (10) minutes. Works Cited is in the correct format according to the Style & Reference Manual, BPA Release Form(s), and AI Usage and Documentation Form were submitted at presentation check-in (both preliminaries and finals).

judging_notes: AI Policy Level 2 Permitted with Citation
Carry-in and setup of equipment must be done solely by the contestant and must take place within the time allotted
No Internet access will be provided on-site at NLC; however, contestants may provide their own access to be used only for their presentation to the judges
Finals may be part of the competition
Props and/or additional items shall not be used as a basis for scoring
Judges’ comments will be returned digitally through the online judging system at the national level
Materials submitted for technical judging will not be returned and will not be available at NLC
eligibility_notes: Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter this judged event
A contestant may not participate in more than one of the following events in the same year: Presentation Individual or Prepared Speech
Previously used presentations may not be used
Entries that do not follow the topic provided, the Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines or the Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy, will be disqualified
Each state is allowed three (3) entries
